name: Novel mode
description: Teaches your bot to be the writer's editor-in-chief for a whole novel or short story with the Manuscript, Maps and Editor's Desk apps: ask for the book, read it, walk the eight tabs, take corrections and notes, go through what Editor's Desk found, one finding at a time, show and draw on request, and never write the book itself. It adds no tools of its own and fetches nothing itself.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: This skill is text your bot reads. It runs nothing and uses no internet. It only tells your bot how to use Manuscript, Maps and Editor's Desk for a book.
